headline: Colombia Forecasts Total Factor Productivity of 0.8% and 7.8% Wage Hike
summary: Macroeconomic calculations combining 7% inflation with a 0.8% total factor productivity metric point toward a 7.8% minimum wage increase for Colombia in 2027.
why: Minimum wage determinations set wage baselines across Latin American formal economies, directly influencing consumer price index expectations.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Anticipated wage growth above inflation influences cost-of-living index trends and labor costs.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
